palette.$description: The Beatham palette library: colour-only palettes a sub-brand may adopt as its secondary or tertiary colours (subbrand.json → palettes). Colour only — no type, radius or style comes with them. For marketing, illustration, previews, packaging and physical parts. They never fill a semantic role (brand:check fails if one does), are exempt from the contrast check and are mode-independent.

filament.$description: The filaments Jeremiah prints with most, sampled from photos — approximate. Manufacturer names and codes are recorded (or still TODO) in brand/inputs/filaments.json. His mixes: (a) 65 light gray / 25 orange / 10 black or space gray; (b) 60 light gray / 30 space gray or black / 10 orange.

light-gray.$description: Light-gray filament (photo sample). The body of a part.

orange.$description: Orange filament (photo sample). Only 1.47:1 against light gray — outline or label it with black or space gray.

gilt.$description: Gilt — a brass rule on a walnut bench. Built from Jeremiah’s gold → brown spectrum. Proportion 70 walnut / 20 cream / 10 brass.

cream.$description: Paper and type on walnut (his gold swatch 1).

two-tone.$description: Two-Tone — a dark instrument cluster over a light part. Jeremiah’s filament colours, verbatim. Proportion 60 part / 30 chrome / 10 signal (his mix b).

signal.$description: Orange filament. Only 1.47:1 against part — outline or label it with edge.

blueprint.$description: Blueprint — the drawing office: white lines on deep Callout blue, an orange pencil. Proportion 70 ground / 20 line / 10 pencil.

pencil.$description: Orange filament — what is being marked up.
